visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark, wavy hair, dressed in a light purple off-the-shoulder knit sweater and blue denim jeans, stands behind a clean white kitchen island. She is looking down intently at a smartphone that is lying flat on the counter, connected to a prominent pink charging cable. (2) She carefully picks up the smartphone and disconnects the pink cable. Next to it, she picks up a matching pink rectangular power bank and a small white cosmetic tube. She opens her white leather shoulder bag and neatly places both items inside while maintaining a neutral but focused facial expression. (3) The woman then reaches for a gold-colored round makeup compact and a smaller white tube remaining on the counter. She examines the compact briefly before sliding it and the smartphone into the bag. She then zips the bag closed with a smooth, practiced motion, preparing to leave. (4) Shifting her weight, she picks up the white handbag and drapes it over her shoulder. She looks directly into the camera lens, breaking the fourth wall with a bright and confident smile, then pivots to her left and walks gracefully out of the camera's view.
